title: Why Do Foxes Hunt by Compass? 🦊 #Shorts
description:
Red foxes dive headfirst into deep snow to catch mice they can't see — with a hunting pounce called mousing.
Scientists found foxes pouncing toward the northeast killed on 73% of jumps vs 18% from other directions, likely using Earth's magnetic field as a rangefinder.
